public_rationale: The driving record supports substantial early capability followed by persistent difficulty with rare safety-critical cases. Waymo's deployment also shows major practical progress. These records do not establish the broader claim that initial AI development is often easy and the remaining work extremely difficult, using comparable measures of effort and correctness. The heuristic is plausible but not settled by the evidence collected.
limitations: Distance automated is not equivalent to correctness across all driving situations.
The research comment explains a technical difficulty rather than surveying development effort.
Deployment success neither proves complete reliability nor refutes disproportionate difficulty with residual cases.
